units.key: Why are some people in your life important?

grammar.title: 定冠词 the
grammar.tip: the 用来「特指」：说话双方都知道说的是哪一个时就用它；第一次提到时一般用 a / an。常见用法：再次提到（I saw a girl. The girl was Lucy.）、独一无二的东西（the sun, the world）、最高级和序数词前（the best, the first prize），以及 in the future 这类固定说法。注意：球类运动和三餐前不用 the，如 play football, have lunch；但西洋乐器前要用，如 play the piano。

boss.name: 象群奶奶
boss.hello: I'm Nana Elephant. I take care of my family. Who is important to you?

sents: My grandpa used to be a bus driver.
我爷爷以前是一名公交车司机。
Our community has a medical centre.
我们社区有一个医疗中心。
My sister makes new friends wherever she goes.
我姐姐无论走到哪里都能交到新朋友。
My mum makes the best fried rice in the world.
我妈妈做的炒饭是世界上最好吃的。
Our English teacher is strict about our homework.
我们的英语老师对我们的作业要求很严格。
Our teacher encourages us when we want to give up.
我们想放弃的时候，老师会鼓励我们。
We should pay attention to the teacher.
我们应该专心听老师讲。
I have lots of relatives in the countryside.
我在乡下有很多亲戚。
My dad works hard on a building site.
我爸爸在建筑工地上辛苦地工作。
To me, my dad is a real superman.
对我来说，爸爸是一个真正的超人。
The streets in my grandpa's village are very narrow.
我爷爷村子里的街道非常窄。
I am seldom bored when I play with my cousin.
和表弟一起玩的时候，我很少觉得无聊。
Our class won the competition for the first time.
我们班第一次赢得了这项比赛。
Online friends are part of my social circle.
网友是我社交圈的一部分。
My aunt has a very active personality.
我姑姑的性格非常活泼。
I want to be a teacher in the future.
我将来想当一名老师。
dlgs: Why is your grandma important to you?
Because she always gives me good advice.
She is at the community centre.
Yes, she is very important to me.
What is your English teacher like?
She is strict but very cheerful.
She has long black hair.
She likes reading and swimming.
When did your grandpa retire?
He retired three years ago.
He worked at the hospital.
Because he was very tired.
Can I play games on your smartphone?
Yes, but please use it wisely.
I often play games on Sundays.
No, thanks. I am not hungry.
Where does your dad work?
He works on a building site.
He works very hard.
He goes to work by bike.
What does your dad wear at work?
He wears an orange uniform.
He wears it every day.
He gets to work at seven.
What does your dad do after work?
He has a hot shower first.
He gets up at six.
He is a hard worker.
Who is the smartest person in your family?
My sister is the smartest.
My family is very big.
She is in the kitchen.
What is the best characteristic of your teacher?
She is always patient with us.
She is in the classroom now.
She teaches us maths.
What topic will you write about?
I will write about the person I like most.
I will write it on the computer.
I will write it after dinner this evening.
Are you worried about the singing competition?
Yes, a little. It is coming soon.
Yes, I am not worried at all.
No, I am good at maths.
How often do you see your relatives?
I seldom see them, only at the Spring Festival.
I see them at my grandma's house in the countryside.
They are very cheerful and friendly people.

talk.name: Grandma Hazel
talk.topic: An important person in your life
talk.topicZh: 介绍你生活中重要的人
talk.persona: You are Grandma Hazel, a cheerful retired doctor who gives health advice at the Echo Island community centre. You are making a photo album called People Around Us, so you love hearing about the important people in children's lives.
talk.goal: Tell Grandma Hazel about one important person in your life: who the person is, what he or she is like, what he or she does, and why he or she is important to you.
talk.goalZh: 向黑兹尔奶奶介绍你生活中一个重要的人：是谁、性格怎么样、做什么工作或平时常做什么，以及为什么对你很重要。
talk.opener: Hello, dear! I'm Grandma Hazel. Who is the most important person in your life?

units.key: What makes a great travel destination?

grammar.title: 专有名词；连词 and、but、so
grammar.tip: 专有名词指具体的人名、地名、国家、语言、星期和月份等，每个实词的首字母都要大写，如 Paris、the Great Wall、French、July。连词 and 表示并列（和、又），but 表示转折（但是），so 表示结果（所以）。but 和 so 连接两个完整的句子时，前面通常加逗号：The lift was full, so we took the stairs.

boss.name: 环球信鸽
boss.hello: Coo! I'm Postie the pigeon. I carry postcards around the world. What makes a great destination?

sents: Paris lies in the north of France.
巴黎位于法国北部。
The lift was full, so we took the stairs.
电梯满了，所以我们走了楼梯。
That café is small, but its cakes taste excellent.
那家咖啡馆很小，但它的蛋糕味道好极了。
Zhangjiajie is famous for its huge stone pillars.
张家界以巨大的石柱闻名。
The mountain range stretches for hundreds of kilometres.
这条山脉绵延数百公里。
These bags are made by hand, so they cost more.
这些包是手工制作的，所以价格更高。
Our city receives lots of visitors every spring.
我们的城市每年春天都接待很多游客。
The coast of Hainan is perfect for swimming.
海南的海岸非常适合游泳。
Golden monkeys remain endangered, so we must protect them.
金丝猴仍然是濒危动物，所以我们必须保护它们。
The government set up the Giant Panda National Park.
政府设立了大熊猫国家公园。
Yellowstone sits on a volcano, so it has many hot springs.
黄石公园坐落在一座火山上，所以那里有很多温泉。
We rode snowmobiles but did not see any wolves.
我们坐了雪地机动车，但一只狼也没看到。
Can you imagine a unique hotel under the sea?
你能想象一家独特的海底酒店吗？
My parents and I went sightseeing in Shanghai.
我和爸爸妈妈去上海观光了。
Kunming is like spring all year round.
昆明一年到头都像春天一样。
Friendly people are key to a great destination.
好的旅游目的地，关键在于友好的人。
dlgs: Where are you going on your trip?
We're going to Paris in France.
We're going there by plane.
We're staying for two weeks.
How are you going to travel to Beijing?
We're going to take the train.
We're going there in July.
We're going with my cousins.
How was the weather in London?
It was cloudy, but we had a great time.
It was a big city with many parks.
We flew there with my parents.
Why did you go into the department store?
It started to rain, so we went inside.
We stayed there for an hour.
It was next to the old bridge.
Which country is the Eiffel Tower in?
It's in France, in the city of Paris.
It's about three hundred metres tall.
You can take the lift to the top.
Did you take the lift up the tower?
No, it was too busy, so we climbed the steps.
Yes, we went there by plane.
No, we stayed in a small hotel.
What makes a great travel destination?
Rich culture, friendly people and excellent food.
I went there with my family.
It takes two hours by plane.
Would you prefer to go hiking or go sightseeing?
I'd prefer to go hiking. I love nature.
Yes, I'd love to go with you.
We went there by bus last year.
Can we see giant pandas in the wild?
Maybe, but they are very hard to find.
Yes, they are black and white.
They eat bamboo all day long.
What's the address of your hotel?
It's twelve Station Road.
It's very clean and quiet.
We stayed there for three nights.
Did you receive my postcard from Hangzhou?
Yes, I did. The picture of West Lake is lovely.
No, I didn't send you a postcard.
Yes, I'm going to Hangzhou tomorrow.
Is the volcano on Echo Island dangerous?
No, it's asleep, so it's safe to visit.
Yes, I took lots of photos there.
No, it's next to the hot spring.

talk.name: Felix
talk.persona: You are Felix, a friendly travel guide at the harbour on Echo Island. You have travelled to many countries and you love helping young travellers plan a great trip.
talk.goal: Plan a dream trip with Felix. Name a destination and the country it lies in. Give two reasons why it is great, using and, but or so. Then say how you will travel there.
talk.goalZh: 和导游费利克斯规划一次梦想旅行：说出目的地和它所在的国家，用 and、but 或 so 说两个它很棒的理由，再说说你打算怎么去。
talk.opener: Hello, I'm Felix, the travel guide at the harbour. Where would you like to go?
words: We're going to take the train

grammar.title: 现在进行时
grammar.tip: 现在进行时说的是此刻正在做、或这段时间正在进行的事，结构是 am / is / are + 动词-ing：Look! Tom is digging a hole. 问句把 am / is / are 提到主语前面，回答也用它：Are they planting trees? — Yes, they are.（别答成 Yes, they do。）加 -ing 要注意 dig → digging、make → making。

boss.name: 老榕树精
boss.hello: I'm Old Banyan, your silent friend. Why do you need trees?

sents: Trees take in greenhouse gases from the air.
树木从空气中吸收温室气体。
Trees produce oxygen for humans.
树木为人类制造氧气。
Trees create a better environment for us.
树木为我们创造更好的环境。
Many paper products come from trees.
许多纸制品来自树木。
Paper makes our lives more convenient.
纸让我们的生活更方便。
Many people overlook the value of trees.
许多人忽视了树木的价值。
We should treat trees as friends.
我们应该把树木当作朋友来对待。
We can borrow books instead of buying new ones.
我们可以借书，而不是买新书。
Are you using both sides of the paper?
你在使用纸的两面吗？
Our school is calling on everyone to plant trees.
我们学校正在号召大家植树。
Look! Tom is digging a hole for a young tree.
看！汤姆正在为一棵小树挖坑。
Lily is pushing a stick into the ground.
莉莉正在把一根木棍插进土里。
A bird is building a nest on a branch.
一只鸟正在树枝上筑巢。
The children are looking around the forest.
孩子们正在森林里四处察看。
My grandpa is making furniture from wood.
我爷爷正在用木头做家具。
The knowledge in Cha Jing spread to many countries.
《茶经》里的知识传到了许多国家。
dlgs: Why do we need trees?
To begin with, they give us oxygen.
In the forest near our school.
Yes, we need them very much.
What are the students doing on the hill?
They are digging holes for young trees.
They dug holes here last spring.
They are students from our school.
Is your brother reading a book?
No, he isn't. He is drawing a tree.
No, he doesn't. He draws trees.
Yes, he does. He reads every day.
Look! What is that bird doing?
It is sitting on a high branch.
It is a small brown bird.
It sat on the roof yesterday.
What are you doing with that old wood?
I am making a birdhouse with it.
It comes from an old tree.
I made a birdhouse last week.
Are Tom and Lily planting a tree?
Yes, they are. They are watering it now.
Yes, they do. They water it every day.
No, they don't. They like flowers.
Hello! Where are you reporting from today?
I'm reporting from Echo Island Forest Park.
I report the news every evening.
I'm reporting the news about trees.
What is your desk made of?
It is made of wood.
It is made in Shanghai.
It is next to the window.
How can we save paper and trees?
For example, we can borrow books from the library.
For example, we can buy more new books.
For example, trees give us fresh air.
Can trees communicate with each other?
Yes, they can. They send messages through their roots.
Yes, they are. They are very old.
No, they don't. They are silent.
How did people first find tea?
According to an old story, they found it by accident.
According to an old story, it is good for you.
According to an old story, people drink it every day.
Lu Yu wrote Cha Jing. Can people in other countries read it?
Yes. There are translations in many languages.
Yes, it has many old characters.
No, it is not about tea.

talk.name: Doctor Fern
talk.topic: Why we need trees and how to save them
talk.topicZh: 我们为什么需要树木、怎样保护树木
talk.persona: You are Doctor Fern, a kind forest scientist who studies the old trees on Echo Island. Today is Tree Planting Day, and you are collecting young people's ideas for a booklet about trees for the island school.
talk.goal: The student gives Doctor Fern at least two reasons why we need trees and at least two ways of saving trees (for example using both sides of the paper or borrowing books instead of buying them), and says one thing he or she or other people are doing for trees these days, using the present continuous.
talk.goalZh: 告诉芬恩博士至少两个我们需要树木的理由和两个保护树木的办法（比如纸两面用、借书不买书），再用现在进行时说一件你或别人最近正在为树木做的事。
talk.opener: Hello! I'm Doctor Fern, a forest scientist. Why do we need trees?
words: use both sides of the paper
borrow books instead of buying them

units.key: Why are animals important to us?

grammar.title: 反身代词和方位介词
grammar.tip: 反身代词表示“……自己”：myself、yourself、himself、herself、itself、ourselves、yourselves、themselves，要和前面说的人对上，如 Did you make it yourself? — Yes, I made it myself. by oneself 表示“独自”。方位介词说东西在哪儿：in、on、under、behind、next to、in front of、between，如 The puppy is asleep under the table.

boss.name: 导盲犬路路
boss.hello: Woof! I'm Lulu, a guide dog and my owner's eyes. Why are animals important to us?

sents: A guide dog can lead a blind man to the shop.
导盲犬能把盲人领到商店。
Pets are not allowed in our school library.
我们学校图书馆不允许带宠物进入。
The receptionist apologized to the guest.
接待员向那位房客道了歉。
The fireman stopped the fire engine in front of the hotel.
消防员把消防车停在了酒店前面。
You must get down under the smoke.
你必须俯下身子，待在烟雾下面。
The puppy fell asleep between two cats.
小狗在两只猫中间睡着了。
A grey shark is swimming under us.
一条灰色的鲨鱼正在我们下面游。
Dolphins can recognize themselves in a mirror.
海豚能认出镜子里的自己。
The blind man can look after himself.
这位盲人能照顾好自己。
Bees make honey to feed themselves.
蜜蜂酿蜜来养活自己。
Wool is a material for making clothes.
羊毛是一种做衣服的材料。
Our hens are a good source of fresh eggs.
我们的母鸡是新鲜鸡蛋的好来源。
Our team made a poster about extinct animals.
我们组做了一张关于已灭绝动物的海报。
Guide dogs are a type of service dog.
导盲犬是服务犬的一种。
Search-and-rescue dogs can find people under the snow.
搜救犬能找到埋在雪下的人。
We must make an effort to save wild animals.
我们必须努力拯救野生动物。
dlgs: Where is the puppy?
It's asleep under the table.
It's two months old.
It's black and white.
Did you make this birdhouse yourself?
Yes, I made it myself.
Yes, you made it yourself.
Yes, he made it himself.
Did you enjoy yourselves on the farm?
Yes, we enjoyed ourselves very much.
Yes, they enjoyed themselves very much.
Yes, I enjoyed myself at home.
Help yourself to some honey.
Thank you. I love honey.
You're welcome. It's my pleasure.
Sorry. I can't help you.
Where is the fire engine?
It's next to the school gate.
It's red and very big.
It's very fast and loud.
Sorry, sir. We don't allow dogs in this hotel.
But she's my guide dog. I'm blind.
Yes, please. I'd like a big room.
Good idea. Let's go inside.
Why do we need search-and-rescue dogs?
They find people after a disaster.
They lead blind people across roads.
They guard sheep on the farm.
Are you scared of sharks?
Yes, I am. They have big teeth.
Yes, I do. I love sharks.
Yes, they are. They swim fast.
Lily doesn't like snakes. What about you?
I don't like them either.
She doesn't like them either.
Yes, she does. She loves them.
When did people first keep dogs?
Probably sometime thousands of years ago.
Probably somewhere in the forest.
Because dogs are very clever.
What do farmers use horses for?
They use them to transport things.
They use them to get wool.
They use them to get honey.
Why are animals important to us?
They give us food and help us in many ways.
They live in forests and seas.
They sleep a lot in winter.

talk.name: Doctor Amy
talk.persona: You are Doctor Amy, a kind animal doctor on Echo Island who looks after pets, farm animals and guide dogs. You are helping the island school make a presentation called Our animal friends, so you want to hear about the student's favourite animal.
talk.goal: Tell Doctor Amy about one animal friend, such as a pet, a farm animal or a working dog: what it looks like, where it likes to sleep or live (use a word like under, next to or behind), and how it helps people. Then say one reason why animals are important to us.
talk.goalZh: 向艾米医生介绍一种动物朋友（宠物、农场动物或工作犬）：它长什么样、喜欢睡在或住在哪里（用上 under、next to、behind 这类词），它怎样帮助人们；最后说一个动物对我们很重要的理由。
talk.opener: Hello! I'm Doctor Amy, the island animal doctor. Which animal do you like best?

units.key: What does water mean to us?

grammar.title: 数量的表达（可数与不可数名词）
grammar.tip: 可数名词有复数（drops、taps、bottles），用 many、a few，问数量用 How many；不可数名词没有复数（water、salt、money），用 much、a little，问数量用 How much，要数它就加量词：a glass of water、two bottles of water。a lot of、some、any 两种名词都能用：some 多用在肯定句里，any 多用在否定句和疑问句里。例：How much water do you drink? — About six glasses. / There are a few drops of water in the bottle.

boss.name: 河鸭水管家
boss.hello: I'm Brook the duck. I look after the river. What does water mean to you?

sents: How much water do you use for a bath?
你洗一次澡要用多少水？
Your brain needs a lot of water to work well.
你的大脑需要大量的水才能正常工作。
There are a few drops of water in the bottle.
瓶子里有几滴水。
How many bottles of drinking water do we need?
我们需要多少瓶饮用水？
Make sure you don't waste any water.
一定不要浪费任何水。
A little water came out of the tap.
水龙头里流出了一点儿水。
A bigger population needs more water.
人口越多，需要的水就越多。
Trade brought the city a lot of income.
贸易给这座城市带来了大量收入。
Nearly all the water on Earth is salt water.
地球上几乎所有的水都是咸水。
A drop of water goes on a long journey.
一滴水要经历一段漫长的旅程。
The water rushed out of the broken pipe.
水从破裂的管道里冲了出来。
Water plays an important role in agriculture.
水在农业中起着重要的作用。
It is our duty to save water.
节约用水是我们的责任。
Water is part of our everyday life.
水是我们日常生活的一部分。
World Water Day is a global event.
世界水日是一个全球性的活动。
Water can change its form.
水能改变自己的形态。
dlgs: When should I drink water?
Drink a little throughout the day.
Drink it from a big glass.
Because it is good for you.
Is there any drinking water in the bottle?
Yes, there is a little.
Yes, there are a few.
Yes, it is a bottle.
How many bottles of water did you buy?
I bought three bottles.
I bought them at the shop.
I bought them last week.
How much of your body is water?
More than half of it.
More than six of them.
Every day after school.
Why didn't you have a bath last night?
A pipe broke. As a result, we had no water.
The tap was fixed. As a result, I had a bath.
It was hot. As a result, I drank more water.
Why was water important for early industry?
Steam engines needed a lot of water.
Workers liked swimming after work.
Factories had very big windows.
Is the water too hot for a bath?
No, it's only a bit warm.
Yes, I had a bath yesterday.
No, it's next to the bathroom.
What can we do to save water?
We can fix the broken taps.
We can take long baths.
We can leave the taps on.
Oh no! Water is rushing out of the pipe!
Let's call someone to fix it at once.
Let's take a long bath at once.
Let's open all the taps at once.
Where does a drop of rain go in the end?
It eventually returns to the sea.
It came down last night.
It is a very small drop.
What does water mean to us?
Water is life. We can't live without it.
It comes from the tap.
It's about two litres a day.
How did the river help business in the city?
Ships carried the city's goods overseas.
The river was cold and deep.
I visited the city last year.

talk.name: Aunt Wendy
talk.topic: Using and saving water at home
talk.persona: You are Aunt Wendy, a friendly engineer at the waterworks on Echo Island. You make sure every home on the island gets clean drinking water, and you are collecting students' water-saving tips for a World Water Day presentation.
talk.goal: The student tells Wendy at least three ways their family uses water every day, says how much water they use with a lot of, a little or a glass of, and gives two water-saving tips, for example fixing taps or taking short showers.
talk.goalZh: 向温迪阿姨说出你家每天用水的至少三种方式，用 a lot of、a little、a glass of 等说说用了多少水，再给出两条节水小建议。
talk.opener: Hi, I'm Aunt Wendy from the waterworks. How much water do you drink every day?

units.key: What role does electricity play in our daily lives?

grammar.title: 情态动词 can / may / must
grammar.tip: can / cannot 说「能不能、可不可以」；may / may not 更礼貌地说「可不可以」，也能表示「可能」；must 是「必须」，must not 是「绝对不许」。它们后面都跟动词原形：May I use your tablet? You must not touch plugs with wet hands. 回答 Must I…? 想说「不必」，用 No, you don't have to. 不要说 No, you must not.

boss.name: 插头刺猬
boss.hello: I'm Ziggy. My spikes are all plugs! What role does electricity play in your life?

sents: Electricity plays an important role in our daily lives.
电在我们的日常生活中起着重要作用。
You must not touch electrical appliances with wet hands.
你绝不能用湿手碰电器。
The yogurt may go bad without a fridge.
没有冰箱，酸奶可能会变质。
What do these household appliances have in common?
这些家用电器有什么共同点？
May I use your tablet for a while?
我可以用一会儿你的平板电脑吗？
We have run out of batteries for the torch.
我们手电筒的电池用完了。
My tablet cannot connect to the Internet.
我的平板电脑连不上网。
You must read the instructions before using the device.
使用这个设备之前，你必须先读说明书。
You may not play video games after nine o'clock.
九点以后你不可以玩电子游戏。
We must follow the safety rules at home.
在家里我们必须遵守安全规则。
Electric cars are powered by batteries.
电动汽车靠电池驱动。
My family had a switch-off weekend.
我家过了一个“关电周末”。
The air conditioner uses a large amount of electricity.
空调的耗电量很大。
Many famous landmarks go dark during Earth Hour.
许多著名地标在“地球一小时”期间熄灯。
Do you care about climate change?
你关注气候变化吗？
Everyone can join in Earth Hour.
人人都可以参加“地球一小时”活动。

grammar.title: 感叹句和祈使句
grammar.tip: 感叹句表达强烈的感情：What 修饰名词，可数名词单数前要加 a/an（What a brave smokejumper she is!），不可数名词前不加（What great news!）；How 修饰形容词或副词（How hard he works!）。祈使句用动词原形开头，表示请求、建议或命令；否定在前面加 Don't 或 Never，提议用 Let's（Don't give up! / Let's make a video clip!）。祈使句 + and 表示「这样做，就会……」：Never give up, and you will achieve your dream. 祈使句 + otherwise 表示「不这样做，就会……」：Keep fit, otherwise you won't be able to become a smokejumper.

grammar.title: 时间状语从句；used to
grammar.tip: when（当……时）、before（……之前）、after（……之后）、until（直到）、as soon as（一……就）引导时间状语从句，说明事情什么时候发生。从句放句首时，后面要加逗号。主句说将来的事时，从句仍用一般现在时：I'll go outside after I finish my homework. 说“过去常常、现在不再”用 used to + 动词原形，否定说 didn't use to，提问说 Did you use to + 动词原形：I used to be shy, but now I love performing.
